about: Provenance of damit_runner/core/metalflood/ (the GPU flood engine). Each file is a byte-for-byte copy of DamSafety_Runner/core/metalflood/ at the commit below. That commit is the head of DWR_Plugins #399, a DRAFT pull request not merged into DWR_Plugins main, so scripts/check_engine_parity.py cannot check these files: PARITY.json stays synced to 5d2ec3b, which has no metalflood folder, and its pairs for these files are skipped there. tests/test_gpu_engine.py checks the sha256 below so an edit here is noticed. When #399 merges and PARITY.json is synced (with the DamSafety changes since 5d2ec3b actually ported), the parity gate takes over and this file can go.
